packageRules.description: One pull request for everything. There are two actions and one toolchain pin in this repository, so separate pull requests would be noise and three CI runs rather than one.

cinc-workstation.description: Cinc Workstation releases, as omnitruck reports them. The endpoint answers with a bare JSON array of version strings, so it is reshaped into the releases list Renovate expects.

customManagers.description: The Cinc Workstation version CI installs. It is a plain input default rather than anything a package manager knows about, so the comment above it is what marks it as a dependency.
